So, I've been reading up on the election, and the way I see it there are four main reasons that Donald Trump will probably have trouble winning a second term.

            One, he's the oldest President ever elected. He might well not be in shape to run again after four years. 

Two, his Republican voters expect specific things out of him. Things that, in many cases, the President lacks the authority to do. If Trump fails to deliver on his grandiose promises, his supporters will disavow him and feel betrayed.  

 The third reason is that, by running a campaign dedicated to overturning the status quo, Trump has, in effect, become the new status quo. In 2020, Democrats will once again be the party campaigning for change.

       The final reason that Trump could lose in 2020 is, ironically, because he has already won. Before the election, there was a general belief among Democrats that Trump could never win. That indifference is what allowed him to win. Now that their belief has been proven wrong, many Democrats will re-evaluate their past choices and become more committed to voting in the next election.  campaign dedicated to overturning the status quo, Trump has, in effect, become the new status quo.
